newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal corporate investment seen down 2 pct '97.
newsitem.headline: Portugal corporate investment seen down 2 pct '97.

text.p: Investment by Portuguese companies is expected to ease by two percent in 1997 after an identical drop in 1996, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said.
"The value of company investment should have fallen by two percent in 1996, according to the results of a poll of companies carried out in October 1996 and January 1997," INE said.
"The companies forecast an identical drop in 1997," it said.
INE said the investment of public companies was expected to grow by 20 percent in 1997 after a 6.3 percent hike in 1996.
But investment by private sector companies was expected to drop by 11 percent in 1997 after a six percent fall in 1996, a statement said.
INE gave no reasons for the trends. It did not say how many companies were questioned in the poll.
